column1: # EXPLICIT record of legitimate changes to imported files after their import (read by build/check-import-provenance.sh).
# A file that differs from its import manifest line and is not listed here makes the check FAIL; so does an entry that no
# longer matches the tree, a stale entry for a file that equals its import, and an unlisted new file under desktop/ or
# release-signer/. Adding or updating a line is a deliberate, reviewed act: run the check with --propose to print candidate
# lines, then write the real reason. Keep ONE line per path: when an already-recorded file changes again, replace its
# current sha256 and extend the reason (separated by "; ").
# Columns, separated by a single TAB:
#   import   sha256 from the import manifest ("-" for added)
#   current  sha256 of the file in the tree now ("-" for removed)
#   reason   who changed it, in which commit, and why (free text)
# This file is the machine-checked record. The narrative of the phase 0C desktop edits (why each file changed) is
# build/imports/EDITED-AFTER-IMPORT-DESKTOP-V1.md; every removed file stays recoverable byte-for-byte with
